messages:
maria: Heads up: EdgeBox (HW partner) wants per-minute metering but devices will often upload offline batches up to 48h late. Need mapping device_id->customer, SKU mapping, HMAC verification, and a reconciliation plan. Any blockers?

 dave: We can accept late batches. Requirements: idempotency on batch_id & event_id, TTL for dedupe, clear error codes for bad signature vs malformed payload.

 li: Proposed SKUs: edge_minutes_v2 (consumption) and edge_seat_license (entitlement). Sample payload (gzipped): {"batch_id":"c2f1e6a2-...","org_id":"org-987","device_id":"edge-01-xy","events":[{"event_id":"evt-100","device_ts":"2026-03-18T16:05:12+02:00","seconds":90}],"seat_count":3,"signature":"sha256=base64..."}

 jen: Two policy questions: 1) attribution when plan changes mid-window (event-time vs invoice-period). 2) timezone handling (partners report local offsets).

 maria: Proposal: convert device_ts to UTC on ingest and attribute consumption to plan effective at event time; prorate if a change crosses event timestamp. Billing rounds up to nearest whole minute; store raw seconds in audit logs.

 dave: Dedupe TTLs: staging 14d, prod 90d. Signature failures -> 401; malformed -> 400; duplicate -> 200 with {ignored:true,reason:duplicate_batch}. We'll add ingestion metrics.

 li: Test harness: ask EdgeBox to POST to staging /v1/marketplace/partner-usage with header X-Partner-Key. Example cURL provided offline. We'll require org_id mapping to active customer in staging.

 jen: Reconciliation: nightly job compares aggregated partner minutes vs our customer aggregation and device counters. Alert if >3% variance rolling 7d or single-day spike >10%. Create console alert + slack channel.

 maria: Operational: late batches mark affected UTC invoice windows as "dirty"; re-aggregation runs automatically and writes audit diffs (old vs new totals). Manual invoice changes need ops approval. We'll need a runbook for reprocessing.

 dave: Entitlements: seat_count updates entitlement table immediately (no backfill). Consumption is backfilled. For idempotency accept event_id dedupe and optional monotonic sequence.

 li: We'll add optional plan_id and plan_effective_at fields to make reconciliation deterministic. PR incoming.

 billing-bot: Sandbox created: org edgebox-sbx-001, sandbox plan edgebox-staging-30d. Staging key sbx-edge-ALPHA. :white_check_mark:

 maria: Next steps: li update partner contract + payload docs; dave implement signature checks/dedupe TTLs/response semantics; jen add alerts + runbook; i'll schedule onboarding & secret exchange Tue 10am PT. We'll verify after they push sample batches. :thumbsup:
